groups.summary: Pre-construction is critical for a successful project outcome.
groups.intro: Pre-construction is critical for a successful project outcome. Our team works closely with the owner and the architect to ensure that all understand the entire scope of the project and define project success. We provide accurate budgets and project schedules early on so our clients can make well-informed decisions.

about.title: About Greystone Construction Company
text: Since 1987, Greystone has provided commercial, industrial, agricultural, general construction and design-build services across the United States.

Our highly skilled and dedicated craft professionals take great pride in their work. Our ability to self-perform specialty trade services provides many advantages to our clients in terms of schedule, budget, quality, and safety.
